description: This file contains the implementation of the Free shipping extension controller for OpenCart, including methods for displaying the configuration page (index) and saving settings (save). It interacts with language files, configuration, models, and view rendering related to shipping free delivery extension.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Free shipping extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration interface for the free shipping extension, including breadcrumbs, language strings, and form data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the POST request to save free shipping extension settings, with permission checks, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
